Task dashboard / Production workflow

DYS-015 — Production Task Graph and Generation Runs

Planned · 0% · Updated 2026-10-18

Goal

Represent asset/shot generation as project data with explicit inputs, dependencies, prompts, outputs and auditable attempts before API integration.

Core entities

  • Production Task: expected output, prompt/template, required inputs, dependencies, target and status.
  • Generation Run: one attempt with effective prompt, model/settings, immutable input snapshot, result and error state.
  • Output: Media Asset and/or concrete Shot Version.

Implementation

  1. Define task/run types, DAG validation and readiness calculation.
  2. Record prompt and reference provenance.
  3. Extend AI plan reconciliation.
  4. Replace the Shot-only checklist with a task-driven manual-first guide.
  5. Add tests for dependency cycles, retries and JSON round-trip.

Specification: Unified Composition Model
